name: Unbox hardware wallet: verify seals then initialize via official suite
goal: Receive a hardware wallet safely by verifying carton and USB-port holographic seals, installing only the official vendor suite, completing authenticity checks, then initializing and backing up before first receive.

source.title: How to Set Up Your Trezor Safe 5 Hardware Wallet: Step-by-Step Guide

prerequisites: Shipment from official shop or authorized reseller
constraints: Educational self-custody/tax procedure only — not financial advice; no coin tips or return promises.
Ground every step in YouTube-provided captions; portable UI names OK when vendor chrome drifts.
Never digitize a seed phrase or enter it into a website/phone camera.
Stop if seals look VOID/tampered and contact vendor.

steps.action: Inspect outer package security seal; confirm intact before opening; contact vendor if unsure.
Inventory box: device, get-started pack (instructions, stickers, two backup cards), USB-C cable.
Verify holographic seal over USB port is not already VOID; remove only when ready to connect.
Connect device, follow redirect to vendor start page, download/install official suite (not a third-party mirror).
Launch suite and complete security checklist that repeats seal guidance; confirm purchase channel advice.
Initialize device and finish backup using on-device screens as source of truth; when receiving, verify full address on the device screen rather than trusting the computer alone.
steps.expect: Backed-up wallet; on-device address verify habit
